etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle English, from Old French, from Latin īnsolēns (“unaccustomed, unwanted, unusual, immoderate, excessive, arrogant, insolent”), from in- (privative prefix) + solēns, present participle of solēre (“to be accustomed, to be wont”).
senses: Insulting in manner or words, particularly in an arrogant or insubordinate manner.
